video_title: LeBron James' Next Team? Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady Weigh In | Cousins

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic needs elite perimeter defenders to support his playmaking
quotes.excerpt: He needs stationary shooting, but that stationary shooting has to be elite defenders.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: As long as Luka Doncic has a rim protector and a lob threat, he needs stationary shooting, but that stationary shooting has to be elite defenders. Because he needs perimeter-oriented guys that are stationary shooters but also can cover him for his lack of defense. You got the rim protector, but your wing, your perimeter guys have to be elite defenders as well as knockdown guys, high-energy guys as well.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Are they competitive in the West still?

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' potential free agency destinations include the Cavaliers and Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I only have two teams that he could go to. Cavs, I feel like, and then probably Golden State.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: This is my theory. I only have two teams that he could go to. Cavs, I feel like, and then probably Golden State. Go back home, and those are my two teams. Go back home to the Cavs, Golden State to me, when I looked at Steve Kerr, who was on his way out, was about to retire, and then all of a sudden, he comes and signs a two-year deal. Something's brewing, bro. Something's cooking up for him to sign that deal because you're not getting any younger. Now he signs this two-year deal, LeBron is a free agent, and we're hearing Steph and LeBron want to play together. We don't know how much of truth to that, but if this is his last year, why not go team up with Steph, Jimmy Butler, and Al in Golden State?

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Well, hell, go get Klay Thompson too. Come on over, bring him back too.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Bro, you talking about a rockstar, stutter team in season everywhere they go. Steph, Curry, LeBron, Jimmy Butler. My guy, you talk to end your career with Steph Curry in the mix. It would be great. Go out that way, bro. Forget what everybody else is saying, man, go play with Steph, bro, and ride that one out. Forget it. That's right. Go ride with Steph, my guy. Steph, Jimmy Butler, and Al Horford. Play with your Olympic coach. Go play for him and see what y'all can do.
